title: Ukrainian and US officials meet for emergency talks on plan to end war with Russia – live
summary: 28-point draft plan widely seen as favourable to Moscow, despite Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 The plan, which endorsed some of Russia’s key demands, emerged after Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev reportedly spent three days with his American counterpart Steve Witkoff in Miami. Witkoff and US secretary of state Marco Rubio had been “quietly” working on the plan with both Russia and Ukraine for around a month, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt told reporters on Thursday. Rubio says the plan was “authored by the US”. Continue reading...
